scenes.text: Translate fractions, decimals and percentages into a common representation before comparing.
Express 2/5 as a decimal. The answer is 0.4. Calculate numerator divided by denominator: 2 divided by 5 equals 0.4.
A learner at a school fair has completed 3/10 of a project. What percentage is equal to that fraction? Pause to choose and explain.
A learner at a school fair has completed 3/10 of a project. What percentage is equal to that fraction? The answer is 30 percent. 3/10 equals 0.3 equals 30 percent.
